# Optional statement about the importance of the paper. The heading can be customized in the language field.
impact-statement: "Scientific programming workflows are becoming increasingly 
complex, while existing support mechanisms remain poorly matched to that complexity.
We believe Quarto Manuals is a step forward in addressing this challenge. With Quarto
Manuals, we hope to make scientific programming more understandable, reproducible,
and maintainable for the people who run them. Quarto Manuals are designed to be able to
meet the needs of novice programmers and experts alike, and scale with the complexity
and capabilities of the workflows they document. Indeed, the Quarto Manual
framework may be complementary — not adversarial — to the growing trend of 
AI-assisted programming, as Manuals may potentially provide a 
[harness](https://github.blog/ai-and-ml/github-copilot/the-harness-is-all-you-need-mostly/) 
for AI-assisted programming to be more understandable, reproducible, and maintainable.

Ultimately, our aim is that Quarto Manuals will help to make scientific 
programming more accessible and inclusive, and support the development 
of a more diverse and equitable scientific community, by providing
a canvas for conducting science that is more user-friendly, less intimidating,
and still able to adhere to rigorous standards of high quality software engineering, 
reproducibility, and transparency."
